frontier.summary: detectable at epsilon = None (non-private); not detectable at epsilon = 31.0307 (eps32); therefore the empirical transition lies between them. Six points do not support interpolating a precise threshold.

association_only_statement: These analyses measure association only. DP noise changes both generalisation and leakage, so this experiment does not identify an effect of DP on membership leakage independently of its effect on memorisation.
